### Ahithophel’s Counsel Defeated
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ahithophels-counsel-defeated
Passage: 2 Samuel 17:14
Points:
- Absalom's rebellion against King David gained significant strength through the strategic counsel of Ahithophel.
- In response to Ahithophel's betrayal, David prayed and sent Hushai to infiltrate Absalom's court and counter the traitor's advice.
- Ahithophel proposed an immediate, lethal strike, but Hushai successfully persuaded Absalom to adopt an alternate strategy.
- Scripture reveals that the Lord ordained the defeat of Ahithophel's sound military advice to bring judgment on Absalom.
- God often uses ordinary human means to frustrate the designs of the wicked and preserve His people.

### God Answers Better Than We Ask
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/god-answers-better-than-we-ask
Passage: 2 Samuel 17:14
Points:
- Faced with fatal danger, David prayed for God to turn Ahithophel's renowned counsel into foolishness.
- Ahithophel's battle plan in 2 Samuel 17 was tactically sound, but God caused Absalom and Israel to favor Hushai's plan instead.
- God orchestrated this sudden turn of events to thwart Ahithophel and deliver David from destruction.
- Rather than answering David's prayer literally, God answered it substantially and far beyond what David imagined.
- Believers do not need to dictate how God should rescue them, because He delights to exceed their requests.

### Bible Pathways 4/17/2001
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-4-or-17-or-2001-550372.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 17:1-11
Points:
- Ahithophel exposed his personal ambition by repeatedly framing the proposed attack on David around himself.
- Hushai skillfully undermined Ahithophel by appealing to Absalom's vanity and reminding him of David's prowess in battle.
- Absalom's pride led him to reject sound advice in favor of commanding a massive national army himself.
- Hushai's counter-proposal granted David vital time to regroup and find safety.
- God worked behind the scenes to answer prayer and protect those who put their trust in Him.
